order_wins: **HFCL** — a three-year supply agreement worth **~USD 244 million (~Rs 2,329 cr, per the filing)** with an undisclosed global multinational for optical fibre cables, through an overseas subsidiary, to December 2029 _(~6.1% of mcap)_.

**Texmaco Rail & Engineering** — a **USD 135 million Letter of Award** from Tsiko Africa Logistics with Barberry Holdings for design, manufacture, supply and commissioning of Wabtec ES43ACi 4,500 HP diesel-electric locomotives; no rupee equivalent is stated.

**Sical Logistics** — a **Rs 534.73 cr Letter of Acceptance from Central Coalfields** for hiring HEMM for overburden removal and extracting 91.036 lakh tonnes of coal at the Dhori area, over five years _(~66.3% of mcap)_.

**Satani Bearings** — **two service orders from National Engineering Industries totalling Rs 376.57 cr** including GST, Rs 125.49 cr for Jaipur and Rs 251.07 cr for Vadodara, both dated 25 August _(~66.5% of mcap)_.
**Marine Electricals (India)** — **orders totalling Rs 229.73 cr from Digital Edge DC (India)** for power distribution systems, excluding taxes, over 15 months _(~4.1% of mcap)_.

**EMS Limited** — declares **Lowest Bidder (L-1) status from the Directorate of Local Bodies, Government of Rajasthan** for sewerage work in six urban local bodies, an estimated Rs 218.65 cr over 18 months; the Letter of Award is still to come _(~10.5% of mcap)_.

**Sugs Lloyd** — Letters of Intent worth a combined **Rs 214.27 cr from TPSODL and TPWODL** for 11 kV and 33 kV network maintenance, over three years from 1 October _(~45.2% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.
**Aarvi Encon** — four work orders worth **Rs 174.73 cr from Certification Engineers International**, a wholly owned Engineers India subsidiary, for manpower hiring to August 2029 _(~82.7% of mcap)_.

**GP Eco Solutions** — restructures its **July-2025 Rs 121.92 cr Welkin EPC contract into direct orders with Garg Acrylics and Nahar Industrial aggregating Rs 76.85 cr**, land and evacuation scope having moved to the end customers.
**OBSC Perfection** — purchase orders worth **Rs 31.40 cr from a domestic auto-components manufacturer** for machined parts under the DaVinci DCx programme, supplied to 2032 _(~1.4% of mcap)_.
**Galaxy Agrico Exports** — a **Rs 10.00 cr purchase order from Shrynax Trading** for 7,90,600 kg of paddy, maize, wheat, bajra, tur and moong _(~6.9% of mcap)_.
**IC Electricals** — purchase orders of about **Rs 6.00 cr from Indian Railways divisions plus a Rs 1.00 cr export order, Rs 7.00 cr in aggregate** _(~3.1% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.
**Shayona Engineering** — a **Rs 4.00 cr service order** from an undisclosed domestic customer for engineering review and technical consultancy, due within six months _(~7.2% of mcap)_.
**Shayona Engineering** — a second such order the same day, **Rs 2.50 cr excluding GST**, again from a customer withheld for confidentiality _(~4.5% of mcap)_.
**Aptech** — a work order from an autonomous body under a state government; the store's line carries Rs 5.66 cr _(~1.1% of mcap)_.

**ANI Integrated Services** — a **Rs 2.16 cr order from ONGC Petro additions** for hiring contract engineers for electrical and instrumentation maintenance at the Dahej petrochemical complex _(~3.3% of mcap)_.

**Antelopus Selan Energy** — the Government of India awards it **two Discovered Small Field Round-IV contract areas**, KG onland and Cambay onland, subject to execution of the revenue sharing contract.
**Asian Energy Services** — its holding and amalgamating company Oilmax Energy is awarded **DSF Round-IV contract area GK/OSDSF/GKOSN/2025**, communicated by the Directorate General of Hydrocarbons.

**ARSS Infrastructure Projects** — a work order from **East Coast Railway** for two road over bridges on the Howrah–Visakhapatnam main line, Khurda Road division; the cached text does not carry a legible value.
**Happy Square Outsourcing** — a third extension of its 2023 work order from **Madhya Pradesh Power Transmission**, about Rs 0.99 cr inclusive of taxes _(~1.9% of mcap)_.
**KPI Green Energy** — a Letter of Intent for a **33.6 / 76.6 MW DC wind-solar hybrid project** under a group-captive arrangement; value not disclosed in the store's line.
**Matrix Geo Solutions** — a **three-year annual rate contract from Adani Infra** for geospatial, LiDAR and surveying solutions; value not disclosed in the store's line.
**Hazoor Multi Projects** — the National Highways Authority of India **withdraws a Letter of Award** issued to the company.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Gujarat Themis Biosyn** — a preferential issue of up to **82,10,786 equity shares of Re 1 at Rs 408, aggregating Rs 335.00 cr**, to named allottees on a private-placement basis, subject to shareholder and exchange approval _(~7.3% of mcap)_.

**Gravity (India)** — approves raising up to **Rs 90 cr via a Qualified Institutions Placement** for working capital and general corporate purposes, subject to shareholder approval _(~735.7% of mcap)_.
**Supreme Engineering** — approves issuing up to **28,09,70,000 equity shares of Re 1 at Rs 2.60**, a premium of Rs 1.60, to promoter and non-promoter allottees, about Rs 73.05 cr on our arithmetic.

**Advance Multitech** — approves **4,00,00,000 warrants convertible into equity at Rs 10 each on a preferential basis**, Rs 40.00 cr on our arithmetic, alongside an authorised-capital increase to Rs 45 cr.
equity_allotments: **Sadbhav Engineering** — approves issuing up to **14,47,94,474 equity shares at Rs 9.34 to its lenders** under the 25 August Master Restructuring Agreement: dues converted, not new cash.
**Cellecor Gadgets** — allots **1,48,11,207 equity shares at Rs 29** on partial conversion of **USD 4.5 million** of its 2% foreign currency convertible bonds due 2031.

**Thomas Scott (India)** — allots **91,575 equity shares at Rs 10 plus a Rs 320 premium** to a non-promoter on conversion of warrants issued under a January 2025 resolution: a past conversion completing.
**Uma Exports** — resets the relevant date to **27 August** and approves a revised valuation for the 2,25,00,000-warrant preferential issue its board cleared on 20 August, after the AGM moved.
m_and_a: **Vertoz** — agrees to acquire **100% of Tavento Labs Inc. for up to Rs 101.00 cr**, discharged substantially by allotting 2,29,54,000 of its own shares at Rs 44 and the balance in cash _(~31.0% of mcap)_.

**Jamna Auto Industries** — completes the acquisition of **100% of Owen Springs Limited**, incorporated in England and Wales, its first international aftermarket presence; the July intimation is now closed.

**India Glycols** — its **demerger into three listed entities becomes effective today**, with IGL Spirits and Ennature Bio Pharma ceasing to be subsidiaries; shareholders on the 2 September record date receive shares in both.
**ITC** — the amalgamation of step-down subsidiaries **Blazeclan Technologies and Cloudlytics Technologies into ITC Infotech** becomes effective today, both standing dissolved without winding up.
**KFin Technologies** — its board approves a **composite scheme amalgamating WebileApps, Hexagram Fintech and WebileApps Technology Services** into the company, subject to NCLT sanction.
**Larsen & Toubro** — the NCLT Mumbai bench **admits the joint petition for its scheme of arrangement with L&T Realty Properties** and lists the hearing for 6 October.
**Go Digit General Insurance** — receives the **Competition Commission's detailed order approving** the amalgamation of Go Digit Infoworks Services into the company.

**Gabriel India** — clarifies that the valuation behind its **28.99% purchase of HL Mando Anand India from promoter Asia Investments**, paid in 1,44,04,204 preferential shares plus cash, uses audited FY26 statements.

**Mukka Proteins** — approves buying **2,93,20,000 shares of Shipwaves Online for Rs 13.19 cr** at Rs 4.50, taking 16.77%; Mukka is a promoter-group entity of the target, so the deal is a related-party transaction at arm's length _(~1.8% of mcap)_.
**Sudarshan Chemical Industries** — executes a definitive share purchase and transfer agreement to sell its **100% stake in VP4 Frankfurt GmbH**, a step-down wholly owned subsidiary.

**Renaissance Global** — step-down subsidiary Renaissance Jewellery Middle East agrees a **strategic investment in branded jewellery player Naman Trading FZC**; the intimation states no consideration.

**Vipul Organics** — membrane unit ADIMEM Technologies buys an **advanced membrane casting, coating and drying platform from Aquaporin, Denmark** through competitive bidding, for relocation to Sayakha; no consideration is stated.
**Ajmera Realty & Infra India** — wholly owned Shree Yogi Realcon contributes **Rs 51,000 for 51% of Ajmera MD Realty LLP**, which becomes a step-down subsidiary.
**Aurobindo Pharma** — incorporates a new wholly owned subsidiary, **Avogent Lifesciences Private Limited**, through Apitoria Pharma.

**Ravindra Energy** — associate Energy In Motion signs a strategic MoU with Oil Field Warehouse & Services and Radiance Green Mobility for the **deployment of 500 electric heavy commercial vehicles**.
**Thomas Cook (India)** — receives BSE's observation letter on its composite scheme of arrangement.
capex_core: **DCM Shriram** — commissions the **main aluminium extrusion plant at its Kota unit**, approved by the board in October 2024; the surface-finish plants are still being installed.

**Welspun Corp** — signs an MoU with **Perma-Pipe, the developers of Jordan's National Water Carrier Project and the Government of Jordan** to build pipe manufacturing and coating facilities there, intending a joint venture.
**Juniper Green Energy** — intimates commencement of commercial production and operations; capacity not stated in the store's line.
business_updates: **Results season** — 13 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.
**Hyundai Motor India** — reports **domestic monthly sales of 54,396 units in August**.
**Coal India** — its **supplies rise 5.5% in August FY27**, the company says in a press release for publication.
**United Breweries** — commissions a **new canning line at its Ellora brewery**, adding Kingfisher capacity in Maharashtra.
**Moneyboxx Finance** — partners with Bachatt to launch a **digital lending platform**, its first step into digital lending.
distress_risk: **Karur Vysya Bank** — the **Income Tax Appellate Tribunal sets aside the CIT (Appeals) order** for assessment year 2022-23, a favourable outcome in a matter first disclosed in April 2024.

**Voltas** — updates the long-running **Qatar claim and counter-claim against OHL International and Contrack (Cyprus)**, after the Court of Appeal's 4 May order in the Kentz-Voltas Consortium's favour.
**JSW Dulux** — receives a **show-cause notice dated 28 August under Section 122 of the CGST Act** from the Gujarat GST department's Ahmedabad North anti-evasion wing.
**Hexagon Nutrition** — the **Commissioner of Customs, Chennai III demands duty, interest and penalty** from amalgamated subsidiary Hexagon Nutrition Exports; the company disagrees on legal advice.
**Everest Industries** — discloses a **GST show-cause notice from Odisha**.
**Diligent Media Corporation** — discloses a **show-cause cum demand notice under GST**.
**Huhtamaki India** — **closes operations of its PS-labels factory at Baddi**.
**Fortis Healthcare** — an update in **Daiichi Sankyo Company, Limited vs Malvinder Mohan Singh and others**.
**Punj Lloyd** — a Regulation 30 disclosure in its **corporate insolvency resolution process**, its company secretary having resigned.
**U. P. Hotels** — calls a board meeting for **7 September to consider voluntary delisting from BSE**, following a SEBI letter of December 2024.
other_notable: **Man Infraconstruction** — an open-market buyback of up to **Rs 169.29 cr**, up to 99 lakh shares at Rs 171 each, 2.45% of paid-up capital and 8.66% of standalone capital and free reserves _(~3.4% of mcap)_.
**Central Depository Services (India)** — **ONDC allots it 5,00,000 shares of Rs 100 for Rs 5.00 cr** on 24 August, a 2.20% stake, completing the further investment SEBI cleared in August.
**TruCap Finance** — an update on the **Marwadi Chandarana open offer**, whose share purchase and subscription agreements were terminated in September 2025 and whose withdrawal request is with SEBI.
**Roadstar Infra Investment Trust** — **Pune Sholapur Road Development Company repays its external borrowings in full**.
